_comment: Global destination allowlist — the hard backstop every sponsored UserOp's target(s) must appear on, regardless of which app requested sponsorship. See README 'Global vs per-app allowlist relationship'. Adding an address here means the paymaster will pay gas for calls to it, so every entry must be a contract we have verified and are willing to fund. Remove an entry to immediately stop sponsoring it.

_entries.0x261eA5971B93237a56990206A46Bc80318e4d0: TapScore (game-app demo contract). Verified on pepuscan. Non-payable tap() only, unbounded per-caller score counter, holds no funds and has no withdrawal path — so the worst case from sponsoring it is wasted gas, not loss of assets. Added to prove end-to-end sponsorship for templates/game-app.
